notes: Centres read from block corners; solid pipe lines and dashed sewers inside the streets ignored. Lakeman x Chase: Chase's north side is off the top of the scan, centre taken on the sewer line / lettering (y about 45), uncertain by 20-30 px. The street meeting Hanfield at 7423,1172 is printed only 'ST.' north of Hanfield and 'WITLER' south of it; taken as Witler Street throughout; its crossing with Chase is off the scan. Hanfield is printed only 'STREET' in this strip, Blue Rock without suffix, Cooper as 'COOPER' (suffix not seen in strip). Hoffner jogs across Colerain: the 55 ft west arm's centre line meets Colerain's at about 8086,5319, the 60 ft east arm's at about 8028,5218; one crossing recorded at the middle of the four corners. Powers likewise: west arm (coming up from the south-west) meets Colerain's centre near 8996,6930, east arm near 9035,6998, the south-east corner is cut by the plate edge; one crossing recorded. McMakin east of Delaney is 12 ft wide (alley width) but printed McMAKIN. Joe Williams meets Blue Rock obliquely; point is where the two centre lines meet, the mouth on Blue Rock's south side lies between about 7925,3165 and 8012,3240. Unnamed alley east of Lakeman near 8046,2185 not picked. Colerain's centre line is straight from 7165,3700 to 9030,6990 (car track runs along it).
